text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- Car dealers, food and alcoholic beverage traders reported the best results of all trading firms in the fourth quarter of 1996, a research by the Warsaw School of Economics Rconomic Development Institute said.

- More than 90 percent of members of the Klub 500, a club of Poland's 500 biggest firms, are convinced that the Polish economic growth will increase after the countyr joins the European Union, the club's president Karol Szwarc said.
- The 1997 public budget assigned 30 million zlotys for water reservoir construction in Swinna Poreba, southern Poland, 20 million zlotys less than needed, the regional water economy board said.
- Over 11,000 legal aliens from 110 countries worked in Poland last year, a report by the State Labour Office (KUP) said.
- Around 220 firms from Poland and abroad took part in the fifth border area international fair organised by the Polish Lithuanian Commercial Chamber in Suwalki, northeastern Poland.
- The Warsaw-based BRE Brokers brokerage house has become a new memeber of the brokerage houses' chamber (IDM), which now includes 34 houses.

- The Raciborz-based Zaklady Elekrtrod Weglowych carbon electrode maker starts a B-series issue of 800,000 shares priced at 38 zlotys per share on Monday, the firm said. The issue has been insured and Societe General guaranteed to take over 600,000 shares for a three percent commission. ZEW's net profit in 1997 will reach six million zlotys, the company's forecast said.
NOWA EUROPA
- Warsaw bourse's WIG index will reach 18.544 points at the end of December this year, a monthly survey of the brokerage houses by Nowa Europa daily said.

- Poland's courier firms' sales have grown 50 percent annually in recent years but the real boom will start after the country joinns the EU, DHL, Pocztex, Servisco, TNT and UPS, the country's biggest courier firms agreed.
- Industrial climate in Poland's construction sector improved in January for the first time in seven months, the Central Statisticasl Office (GUS) said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- Plus GSM and Era GSM digital mobile phone networks have already covered 30 percent of Poland, includung all big city areas, the companies said.
- The Raciborz-based ZEW carbon electode maker will require 85 million zlotys of development funding by 2000, the company said.
ZYCIE
- The general shareholders meeting of Wrozamet gas-stove maker has decided to increase share capital through a closed issue of 193,363 shares priced at 65 zlotys per share.
- Around 85 percent of Polish drivers hold liability insurance policies issued by the PZU SA, Poland's biggest insurance firm, a recent survey by the Estymator polling institute showed.
- Janusz Dabrowski, the Gdansk Market Economy Resarch Institute (IBnGR) director and a leading economic analyst died last week at the age of 38.
